upstream.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.

classification.analysis: Agent Reach is a CLI capability layer that gives AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Windsurf) the ability to read and search Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu, LinkedIn, RSS and general web content without paid APIs. It works by probing an ordered list of free backends per platform (yt-dlp, gh CLI, Jina Reader, OpenCLI, bili-cli, Exa via MCP, etc.), auto-selecting whichever is currently working and reporting status via `agent-reach doctor`. It ships an MCP server integration and a Claude Code SKILL.md so an agent can self-configure without the user writing scraper code. Aimed at solo builders/agent tinkerers who want their coding agent to browse social/web platforms cheaply and reliably.

use_cases.title: Let a coding agent read and summarize a YouTube video via transcript extraction
Give an agent free semantic web search without paying for a search API
Have an agent monitor Reddit/Twitter discussions about a product
Install a Claude Code skill that auto-picks the best scraping backend per platform
